decisive_items: pedunculated bony protrusion arising from the posterolateral plantar aspect of the calcaneus
no thickening of the plantar fascia
response.rationale: MRI shows a pedunculated bony protrusion at the plantar calcaneus, consistent with an enthesophyte; plantar fasciitis and fibromatosis are excluded by normal fascia. Haglund syndrome is typically posterior, not plantar.

rejected.why: Less specific than R2; bone spur is a broader term, while R2 precisely identifies the plantar calcaneal enthesophyte.
Haglund syndrome involves the posterior calcaneus, not the plantar aspect as described.
Gastrocnemius tightness is a contributing factor but not the primary imaging-based diagnosis.
MRI shows no plantar fascia thickening, contradicting fibromatosis.
MRI shows no plantar fascia thickening or signal alteration, excluding plantar fasciitis.
